instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for FramePetal Progress Register: The objective is to review and file construction progress photographs as evidence for identified work packages. Site Photographers submit photographs with work-area and capture-date information. Site Supervisors record depicted work activities and related work packages. Quality Reviewers record whether photographs are clear or require retakes and add retake reasons. Project Records Clerks file clear photographs under related work packages. Construction Managers close photograph requests after filing. Image editing and progress-payment certification are excluded.
